scenes.label: NOBODY TOLD ME
scenes.text: The garage door is the most forgotten entry point in the house. Old remotes still work until you clear them from the opener.

scenes.label: NOBODY TOLD ME
scenes.text: If the house came with a 15-year-old alarm, it’s decor, not protection.

scenes.label: NOBODY TOLD ME
scenes.text: The ages of your furnace, AC, water heater and roof are the four numbers that decide your next decade of big bills.

caption.hook: Three things nobody tells you when they hand over the keys.
caption.feel: None of this is in the closing paperwork. All of it costs money to learn the hard way.
caption.shows: Three “Nobody Told Me” lines from the book: the garage remotes, the old smoke alarm, and the four ages that drive your big bills.
caption.ask: Which one did you already learn the hard way?
